item.title: Write the Cleanup Headline

turns.text: Make a square social graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly illustrated seaside scene, with a short catchy headline — you pick the words. No dates or signup details.

item.tests: Checks that the agent writes and renders a suitable headline rather than asking the user for wording or omitting text.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from square 1:1); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished square social media graphic encouraging people to help clean up their local beach. Friendly contemporary illustrated seaside scene, warm sunshine, soft turquoise ocean waves, sandy beach, dune grass, little seashells, and a cheerful diverse group of adult volunteers picking up a few pieces of litter with litter grabbers and reusable collection buckets. Welcoming, optimistic community spirit, charming hand-drawn shapes with subtle paper texture, cohesive seafoam, coral, sunshine yellow and cream palette. Strong clear composition and generous margins. Include one short catchy headline in large, beautifully legible bold playful lettering, exactly: "Happy Beach, Happy Planet". Include a small supporting line exactly: "Pitch in. Pick up. Make waves." Make the headline prominent at the top and the illustration below, with the supporting line along the bottom. No other text, no dates, no signup details, no logos. Professional editorial illustration and clear visual hierarchy; inviting rather than preachy.
